body: Three stable /api/v1/emily/ endpoints for external RSI orchestration. POST /cycle triggers async RunOnce, GET /state returns CycleState, POST /roadmap/items adds queued item. SONNET_MODEL env var (default claude-sonnet-4-6) for impl-tier LLM calls. Commit EMILY 4e6886b.
title: Emily Prime API — /cycle /state /roadmap/items + SONNET_MODEL
